plain: Several guests point out that in 1947, Roswell, New Mexico, the town at the centre of the most famous UFO crash story, was home to the 509th, America's first atomic bomber unit. The commentator Marik von Rennenkampff calls it "the first bomber squadron" of its kind. The researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala adds that this unit dropped the bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki. The scientist John Brandenburg goes further and says all the world's nuclear weapons were kept there. Michels says Roswell held "the only American nuclear stockpile at the time" and names the officers involved, among them Jesse Marcel Sr., Walter Haut, William Blanchard and Roger Ramey. In another episode he asks whether something happened there, noting the unit was led by the Air Force general Curtis LeMay. The tellers raise it because a crash beside America's nuclear bombers would hint that something was watching them.
